verdict.rationale: Cursor documents MCP support that connects to external tools/data sources, an MCP marketplace with OAuth install, and explicit integration with Slack alongside GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Jira-style trackers, plus Slack-based agent collaboration—covering the story's workflow-tool extension use case. Missing for 10: explicit first-party Jira/Google Drive connector documentation and independent hands-on verification of these integrations working end-to-end.
